get.description:
Returns your organization's overlay on the Yuno provider catalogue: which providers your dashboard offers, and the custom wording, links and logos you have set for them. It is an overlay, not the catalogue — join it onto the provider catalogue rather than reading it as the list of providers.

Branch on `filtered`, never on the length of `providers`: a provider with custom wording but no allowlist entry appears here with `allowed: false`.

This filters a picker. It is not authorization, and it does not stop a connection being created against a provider you do not offer.

filtered.description: Whether the organization has at least one allowlist entry. `false` means a white-label organization currently offers no provider at all (the allowlist is opt-in), not that everything is offered. Branch on this, never on the length of `providers` — the list is also non-empty when the only entries are instruction or logo overrides.

providers.description: The union of the allowlist, the instruction overrides, and the logo overrides. A provider can carry custom wording or a custom logo without being offered, in which case it appears with `allowed: false`.

allowed.description: Whether the organization offers this provider.

has_instruction_override.description: Whether any instruction override exists. A cheap badge flag, redundant with the content fields and not authoritative for rendering them.

name.description: Display name replacing the catalogue's, when overridden. Only Yuno-owned providers can carry one.

instructions.description: Connection steps replacing the catalogue's, when overridden. Absent means keep the catalogue's.

items.description: One instruction step. Accepts `step`, `text`, `text_link`, `link`, `type`, `has_sub_instructions`, `sub_instructions_type` and `sub_instructions` (nested up to 3 levels). `text` and `text_link` are either a plain string or a language map such as `{"EN": "...", "ES": "..."}`. Every `link` must be https.

setup_instructions.description: Grouped setup steps replacing the catalogue's, when overridden. Absent means keep the catalogue's.

items.description: One setup group. Accepts `title`, `order`, `instructions_type` and `instructions` (the same step shape).

more_info_url.description: Documentation link replacing the catalogue's, when overridden. Always https.

logo_url.description: Read-only and ephemeral: a presigned URL minted on this read and valid only for a short window. Never store it — read the provider again for a fresh one.

401.description: Unauthorized — invalid or missing API keys.
